answer_1.quote: The field of machine translation (MT) has made tremendous strides in recent years thanks to neural machine translation (NMT) models that can utilize massive quantities of parallel training data.

answer_2.quote: The quality of the translations produced by each system was first evaluated using a range of automatic translation metrics, including BLEU, METEOR, BERTSCORE, COMET, and BLONDE.

answer_4.guideline: We evaluated two units of linguistic context (SENTENCE and DOCUMENT) independently based on their respective FLUENCY and ADEQUACY. ... The ADEQUACY evaluation was based solely on source texts, whereas neither source texts nor references were included in the FLUENCY evaluation.
